'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**[[2020 Toumour attacks]]
***[[Boko Haram]] kill 28 people and burn down hundreds of homes in [[Toumour]], [[Diffa Region|Diffa]], [[Niger]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-niger-security/gunmen-kill-28-burn-800-houses-in-niger-attack-blamed-on-boko-haram-idUKKBN28O2XT?il=0 (Reuters)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saskatchewan]]
*****[[Saskatchewan]] reports 11 deaths, a new single-day record since the start of the [[pandemic]]. [https://leaderpost.com/news/saskatchewan/saskatchewan-reports-single-day-record-with-11-deaths-274-new-cases (''Regina Leader-Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
*****[[Florida]] surpasses 20,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.orlandosentinel.com/coronavirus/os-ne-florida-coronavirus-saturday-december-12-20201212-ocn3pprz3ze6rhncz3hvbfynfm-story.html (''Orlando Sentinel'')]
****The U.S. surpasses 16 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/health/2020/12/12/covid-vaccine-update-pfizer-vaccine-authorized-first-doses-coming/3893846001/ (''USA Today'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Tokyo]] reports a new single-day record of 621 cases, according to data from the [[Tokyo Metropolitan Government]], bringing the cumulative number of cases in the prefecture to 46,745. [https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20201212_16/amp.html (NHK World)]
****[[Japan]] records a new single-day record of 3,041 cases. The [[Japan Self-Defense Forces]] are deployed to [[Asahikawa]], [[Hokkaido]], where hospitals are facing [[shortages related to the COVID-19 pandemic|shortages]] of medical staff to treat COVID-19 patients. [https://english.kyodonews.net/news/2020/12/a1a95f30ca0c-breaking-news-tokyo-reports-record-621-new-coronavirus-cases.html (Kyodo News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Bangladesh]] surpasses 7,000 total deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.dhakatribune.com/health/coronavirus/2020/12/12/covid-19-death-toll-crosses-7-000-in-bangladesh (''Dhaka Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****[[South Korea]] reports a new record of 950 cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total to 41,736 cases. 928 of the new cases are locally transmitted and more than 70% of these are from the [[Seoul Capital Area]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/south-korea-950-new-covid-19-cases-highest-daily-rise-13756272 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
****[[Belarus]] reports 1,975 cases in the past 24 hours, a new single-day record. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2020/12/12/1st-ld-writethru-belarus-reports-record-single-day-high-of-1975-new-covid-19-cases (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reaches 64,036 total deaths from COVID-19, surpassing the [[United Kingdom]] to have the highest death toll in [[Europe]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/italy-reclaims-highest-death-count-europe-surpassing-uk-1554325 (''Newsweek'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] reports a new case in a person currently quarantining in a hotel. It is the first time that the state has reported a COVID-19 case in more than 40 days. [https://7news.com.au/lifestyle/health-wellbeing/victoria-reports-five-coronavirus-cases-in-hotel-quarantine-for-first-time-in-weeks-c-1754061 (7 News)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Peru]] temporarily suspends [[Phases of clinical research#Phase_III|Phase III]] trials of [[Sinopharm]]'s vaccine after detecting neurological problems in one of its volunteers. Peru's trials for the vaccine were due to conclude this week, after testing around 12,000 people. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/peru-suspends-clinical-trials-china-sinopharm-covid-19-vaccine-13757116 (CNA)]
*[[2020 H5N8 outbreak]]
**[[South Korea]] issues a 48-hour standstill order on all [[poultry farm]]s across the country following a series of highly pathogenic [[Avian influenza|bird flu]] ([[H5N8]]) cases. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20201212000900325?section=business/industry (Yonhap News Agency)]

'''International relations'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Queensland]] reopens its borders to travellers from [[New Zealand]] after 28 days without any community transmission cases. [https://www.canberratimes.com.au/story/7050732/qld-opens-its-border-to-new-zealand/?cs=14231 (''The Canberra Times'')]
*[[Foreign relations of Switzerland]], [[International reactions to the 2020 Belarusian presidential election and protests]]
**[[Switzerland]] freezes [[President of Belarus|Belarusian President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]]'s assets in the country. Lukashenko, his son [[Viktor Lukashenko|Viktor]], and 13 other officials will be banned from entering Switzerland following violent [[2020 Belarusian protests|protests]] that occurred following the [[2020 Belarusian presidential election|election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/swiss-belarus-sanctions/swiss-freeze-assets-of-belarus-leader-lukashenko-idUSL1N2IS062 (Reuters)]
*[[International recognition of Israel]], [[Foreign relations of Bhutan]]
**[[Bhutan]] and [[Israel]] agree to establish full diplomatic relations for the first time. [https://www.jpost.com/international/israel-normalizes-ties-with-bhutan-651904 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
 
'''Law and crime'''
*[[2017–2018 Iranian protests#Government response|Aftermath of 2017–2018 Iranian protests]], [[Capital punishment in Iran]]
**[[Government of Iran|Iranian authorities]] [[capital punishment|execute]] once-exiled [[dissident]] [[journalist]] [[Ruhollah Zam]] over his online work that helped inspire the [[2017–2018 Iranian protests]]. This comes after the [[Supreme Court of Iran|Supreme Court]] upheld the death sentence on Tuesday. [https://www.dw.com/en/ruhollah-zam-iran-executes-journalist-who-inspired-2017-protests/a-55914201 (DW)]
*[[2020 United States election protests]]
**Pro-[[Donald Trump]] protests over the [[2020 United States presidential election]] results are held in [[Washington, D.C.]] Participants included members of the far-right group [[Proud Boys]]. During the demonstrations, four people are stabbed, one is shot, and 33 others are arrested, six for assaulting police officers. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/12/12/us/stop-the-steal-protest-washington-dc-trnd/index.html (CNN)] [https://slate.com/news-and-politics/2020/12/people-stabbed-shot-trump-protests-violent-proud-boys.html (''Slate'')]
